What a provisional does and does not do

A sufficiently supported provisional can establish an earlier filing basis; it is not examined into an issued patent by itself. Written description and necessary drawings matter, and later-added subject matter does not receive the earlier date merely by reference. Plan the corresponding nonprovisional and, if appropriate, international strategy within twelve months of the actual filing date. Record the deadline from the official receipt, not this draft date. Pre-filing disclosure can impair foreign rights. [S1]

Names, slogans, third-party artwork and trade secrets are different issues. This draft does not register Living Table or its slogan as a trademark, does not acquire rights in commercial board-game characters and does not promise worldwide exclusivity or freedom to operate.
